review:
Sweet Bonanza with the same treatment Gates got: identical core game, bigger bomb multipliers and a 25,000x cap.

The base game is unchanged, so sessions feel almost the same until free spins arrive – that's where the extra upside lives. A sensible upgrade if you already know you love the original's bonus. High volatility, 96.53% RTP.
cons: Very little new beyond the numbers
